rules.text: SELECT columns FROM table: pick only the columns you need. A * means every column.
WHERE filters rows. Text goes in single quotes ('Bandung'), numbers do not.
Watch the boundary: "at least 120" means >= 120, not > 120.
ORDER BY column DESC sorts largest first; LIMIT 3 keeps the top 3 rows.
Bar charts must start at 0. A cut axis makes a small difference look huge.
Check the sample size. A claim about "all customers" from 6 people cannot be trusted yet.
Correlation is not causation: two numbers rising together do not prove one causes the other.
Show the full time range. Picking only the good months (cherry-picking) is misleading.
COUNT(*) counts rows, SUM() adds up, AVG() takes the average.
GROUP BY column makes one result row per group, for example per branch.
Filtering grouped results (e.g. COUNT(*) > 2) uses HAVING after GROUP BY, not WHERE.
Do not hard-code numbers like "/ 5". Let SQL calculate from the data.
Names, ID numbers, phone numbers and addresses are personal data. Use them only for purposes the owner agreed to.
Share only what is needed: if summary numbers are enough, do not send per-person data.
Personal data for outsiders or a new purpose: escalate to the Data Protection Officer (DPO).
Never send office data to a personal email or an app the office does not own.
Check for duplicate rows: data recorded twice inflates totals.
An empty value (NULL) is not zero. Find it with IS NULL, not = NULL.
Impossible values (age 230, 31 February) mean an input error. Fix them before calculating.
Clean, consistent data is fine to use. Do not hold work back without a reason.
JOIN table_b ON table_a.column = table_b.column combines rows whose values match.
Link columns that really belong together, e.g. orders.customer_id with customers.id.
AI learns from training data. Lopsided data makes a lopsided AI (bias).
AI assistants can make up facts and sources (hallucination). Check the original source before using it.
Never paste personal data or office secrets into a public AI service.
Training data with personal data used without consent: escalate, do not use it yet.
